correctness.rationale: The stated finite graph and complex are explicitly reconstructed. 450 perfect matchings generate 183,544 faces; 88,171 verified immediate free-face collapses reduce to a four-dimensional core (36,427,1850,3129,1759). Tree and 392 triangle relations kill all 427 edges, proving pi1=0. All oriented boundary compositions vanish; exact column operations exhibit only unit Smith factors with ranks (392,1458,1671) for boundaries 2--4, giving H4=Z^88 and no other reduced homology. Hurewicz plus Whitehead proves the wedge. Signed face-trace Lefschetz calculates all 16 characters and honest integral multiplicities. The checker was executed independently from extracted candidate paths.

value.rationale: The five-layer square cylinder C4 square P5 is the first natural 20-vertex 3-dimensional square-prism extension beyond known cubic prisms and planar grids, with 450 perfect matchings and a nonshellable pure 9-dimensional complex. The exact 88-sphere 4-dimensional homotopy type is not deducible from the cited prism theorems. Beyond a finite Betti number, the full D4 x C2 rational symmetry module and seven-dimensional invariant subspace resolve natural equivariance questions relevant for later cylinder comparisons and quotient topology. The target and invariant are geometrically canonical, not arbitrarily tuned parameters.
